request: Goblin Chef: Not very clean, not very nice, cooks horribly. His smack knocks the target back 2 spaces. He holds a spatula in his right hand; keep held items in the same hand. These are his own signature moves: give him a distinct personality, different from other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Attack
animations.description: Smack: huge sideways spatula swat, like hitting a fly, with a big follow-through ('hit' at contact; the game knocks the target back 2 spaces).
